scope: Controlled unit verification of actual browserFileRepository with fake-indexeddb and recursive Blob/File-put rejection, not native WebKit

rounds.explanation: 16 cases: 7 pass/9 fail. Initial codec cross-realm ArrayBuffer rejection plus an overbroad BOM fixture. Blob.text strips a leading BOM in the existing API; the fixture was corrected to valid raw JSON without BOM, retaining CRLF/Persian/emoji/decomposed accent/escapes. These are historical observations, not current failures.

18 cases:17 pass/1 fail. Per-byte output was equal, but a Node TextEncoder typed-array instance and jsdom typed-array instance failed class-sensitive deep equality. The final assertion compares ordered numeric bytes on both sides, retaining every byte and length.
Final current spec:18/18 pass against the production ArrayBuffer codec. No test edits followed this run; negative-bound confirms the same final spec SHA.
Temporary external .ts config bundled as CJS and failed Tailwind ESM startup; zero tests executed and no JSON result. Renamed external config .mts; no production config was changed.
Qualified old-source negative:18 cases,1 legacy-read pass/17 failures in Blob write paths. Superseded by final hash-bound negative.
Qualified old-source negative after final byte assertion refinement:18 cases,1 legacy-read pass/17 expected write failures. Superseded by explicit before/after source-bound record.

Authoritative final negative:18 cases,1 legacy Blob-read/no-rewrite pass and17 expected failures when old Blob writes meet the observed UnknownError model. All five before/after hashes identical, including the exact final test and live production source. Not native WebKit execution.

limitations: No native WebKit or LAN browser run was performed by this unit task. Native CI must validate the actual browser fix.
